3187.title: Pi directory switch completes, but resume retains the prior cwd
3187.rootCauseOneLine: Pi resume prefers the persisted session-header cwd over the new environment cwd; the reported tool-response hang did not recur.
3187.proposedFix: Define and test a Pi session migration policy for directory changes; capture the released Pi transport boundary before changing response ordering for the unconfirmed hang.
3187.caveats: Two deterministic full-stack Pi runs completed the tool call normally. Both reproduced stale cwd attribution on the next turn; actual released Pi command execution was not exercised.
